location: article p. 13 (PDF p. 14), Experiment 3 Discussion; see also article p. 12 (PDF p. 13), Line discrimination task
quote: Experiment 3’s LDT results are inconsistent with
reason: The target effect is Experiment 3's line discrimination task (LDT) reaction-time comparison between disgusting and frightening photographs (online-first article p. 12, PDF p. 13: t(58) = 0.82, p = 0.418, dz = 0.106, BF = 5.14), which the authors explicitly state on article p. 13 (PDF p. 14) is inconsistent with Chapman's finding and showed no difference in task interference. The shipped 'successful' coding mistakenly relied on the abstract's statement about replicating the free-recall disgust advantage in Experiment 3 rather than the LDT discrimination-speed outcome.
